notes: Target DTOs can receive title/description/order/content, but do not represent objective behavior, evidence alignment, prerequisite graph, workload semantics or quality-gate diagnostics.
No target competency, capability, gap, policy, domain-pack or snapshot contract.
Target document DTOs model training resources; source extraction contracts include CV/JD kind, versioned output, locator/evidence provenance, review status and acceptance boundaries.
Target RBAC role is an access role, not a role competency profile.
Quiz answers and certificates cannot replace evidence items with source, verification and citation metadata.
Target quiz DTOs support question/answer/pass-score behavior; source assessment contracts support rubric, artifact reference, evidence IDs, SME review and decision state.
A source generated plan may project into a target draft path/course graph only after retaining source provenance and approved-gap references.
Course certificates are not competency credentials; source policy and verification state must remain explicit.
Target JWT role checks cannot represent source organization membership, trusted actor context or scoped SME delegation.
